newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - Dec 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- HONG KONG DAILY NEWS -- The structure, staff and function of the office for the Chief Executive-in-waiting of the futue Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) will be similar to that of the Governor, but Secretarial level officials are not included in the team to assist the future Chief Executive.
-- APPLE DAILY -- Some Chinese officials worry that if Chief Secretary Anson Chan remains in her job after the handover, the future Chief Executive may not be able to control her.

-- SING TAO DAILY -- Beijing has instructed that the case involving former Beijing mayor Chen Xitong must be closed before the end of the year. Chen would be charged with malfeasance and may be sentenced to seven years imprisonment.
-- WEN WEI PO -- Deputy governor Chen Yuan of the People's Bank of China said that next year, some joint venture investment companies will be allowed to trade in China's A Share market.

-- Chinese President Jiang Zemin said Chinese people are determined to solve the Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan issues under the principle of "one country two systems". He said Hong Kong will continue to be prosperous and stable after the handover.

-- HONG KONG ECONOMIC TIMES -- The stage three residential development at Hong Kong's Tung Chung airport railway station has attracted 17 developers which formed at least six consortiums to vie for the project.

-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- Britain warned of "a recipe for chaos" if thousands of overseas Hong Kong people are forced to return to the territory ahead of the handover to claim the right of abode.
-- HONGKONG STANDARD -- The Government will sell nearly 900 vacent government flats over the next two years in an attempt to cool the territory's overheated luxury property market.
